spans.s:
शोशुच्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Sorrowing or grieving deeply.
 E. शुच् to be
sorrowful, intens. v., शानच् aff.

शोष m. (-षः)
 1. Pulmonary consumption.
 2. Drying up, dryness.
 3.
Intumescence, swelling.
 4. Emaciation, withering.
 E. शुष् to dry,
aff. घञ् ।

शोषण n. (-णं)
 1. Suction, sucking.
 2. Drying up.
 3.

.
Dry-ginger.
 m. (-णः) One of the arrows of KĀMADEVA, or CUPID.
f. (-णी)
 1. Drying up.
 2. Causing to wither.
 E. शुष् to dry, ल्युट् aff.

शोषयित्वा Ind. Having dried up.
 E. शुष् to dry, causal v., क्त्वा aff.

शोषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Dried, dried up, desiccated.
 E. शुष् to dry, aff. क्त ।
शोस् Ind. A particle of reproach or contempt.
